EPSTEIN FILE CHECK.

Search, submit, classify and route Epstein-related public files into an evidence ledger, review queue, missing-record tracker, Matrix card links, cautious conclusions and Theory Lab.

Evidence Boundary

Appearance in an Epstein-related public file is a research lead, not proof of wrongdoing. This system separates documented fact, sourced analysis, reasonable inference, speculation, unsupported claims, and missing records. No person, company, institution, flight, address, meeting, email, phone number, or association should be treated as proof of serious conduct unless supported by court records, sworn evidence, official findings, judgments, or other reliable public records.

System Flow

Ingest

Accept public source URL, pasted text or placeholder upload.

Extract

OCR and entity extraction placeholder.

Classify

Assign evidence level and confidence.

Route

Suggest cards, dossiers, source ledger and missing records.

Review

Legal-sensitive, unclear or weak items stay in review.

Publish

Only evidence-bounded conclusions are published.
